title: CDC NHANES datasets and documentation
implementation_practice: Match variables to cycle-specific codebooks, component eligibility, file structure and documented missing-value conventions; verify joins and record counts
acceptance_check: Verify data eligibility, identifiers, missingness and the stated source contract
caveat: Variable meaning and availability can change by cycle; do not guess from column names
version_requirement: Confirm active release, applicability and license before deployment

title: CDC NHANES sample design
implementation_practice: Specify strata, primary sampling units and weights for population inference
acceptance_check: Verify data eligibility, identifiers, missingness and the stated source contract
caveat: Treating a complex sample as an unweighted simple random sample can distort precision and estimates
version_requirement: Confirm active release, applicability and license before deployment

title: CDC NHANES weighting
implementation_practice: Select weights according to the smallest analytic subsample and the relevant collection component; handle combined cycles explicitly
acceptance_check: Verify data eligibility, identifiers, missingness and the stated source contract
caveat: Interview weights are not interchangeable with exam or laboratory subsample weights
version_requirement: Confirm active release, applicability and license before deployment

title: R survey package documentation
implementation_practice: Represent complex designs explicitly, then use survey-aware estimators rather than ordinary unweighted standard errors
acceptance_check: Verify data eligibility, identifiers, missingness and the stated source contract
caveat: Inspect current version and variance-design assumptions; this does not validate questionnaire coding
version_requirement: Confirm active release, applicability and license before deployment

title: Bioconductor SummarizedExperiment
implementation_practice: Keep assays, sample metadata and feature metadata aligned by stable identifiers
acceptance_check: Verify data eligibility, identifiers, missingness and the stated source contract
caveat: Assay rows are usually features and columns samples; metadata reordering can silently corrupt interpretations
version_requirement: Confirm active release, applicability and license before deployment

title: STROBE statement
implementation_practice: State study design, participant selection, variables, bias, statistical methods and limitations
acceptance_check: Verify data eligibility, identifiers, missingness and the stated source contract
caveat: Reporting completeness does not establish causal validity
version_requirement: Confirm active release, applicability and license before deployment

title: RECORD statement (EQUATOR)
implementation_practice: Document data provenance, codes/algorithms, linkage, selection and availability
acceptance_check: Verify data eligibility, identifiers, missingness and the stated source contract
caveat: RECORD is a reporting extension, not a substitute for legal/ethical permissions
version_requirement: Confirm active release, applicability and license before deployment

title: NIH DMS Plan guidance
implementation_practice: Describe data management, appropriate access and preservation before release
acceptance_check: Plan names data categories, constraints, preservation and sharing strategy
caveat: Apply the current plan format only when the project is in policy scope
version_requirement: Confirm active release, applicability and license before deployment

title: NCBI GEO high-throughput submissions
implementation_practice: Retain biological sample, protocol and processed-data metadata; use safe, uniquely identified filenames

title: CDISC SDTM
implementation_practice: Keep source observations distinct from standardized clinical trial tabulations
acceptance_check: Explicit source-to-target mapping and schema version when SDTM applies
caveat: Never impose SDTM on unrelated public-health exploratory datasets
version_requirement: Confirm active release, applicability and license before deployment

title: CDISC ADaM
implementation_practice: Document derivations and traceability from source to analysis datasets
acceptance_check: Dataset spec distinguishes analysis variables and derivations
caveat: Applies to compatible clinical study analysis workflows

title: R packages manual

version_requirement: Confirm active release, applicability and license before deployment

title: testthat reference
implementation_practice: Test valid, missing, duplicate, and invalid-input cases; state what is asserted

title: renv
implementation_practice: Snapshot package versions and document restoration

title: Bioconductor developer contributions
